content.short: Assetux lets users buy tokens traded on DEXs of EVM-compatible blockchains using credit cards.
content.description: Assetux enables Web3 projects to diversify how they reach Web2 users by providing a familiar on-ramp: buying tokens with credit cards. Unlike relying on DEXs that force users to pay gas in a blockchain’s native currency, Assetux reduces friction and streamlines the purchase flow. By integrating Assetux, projects can offer token buys without requiring full KYC for transactions up to $1050, making it easier for non-crypto newcomers to participate while staying within practical compliance limits.
